poll.source_locator: Q2 Kansas LV: Adam Hamilton 52, Roger Marshall 43, David Graham (L) 4, Other (vol.) *, Would not vote 1, No opin. *
poll.notes: Question includes a 'which one are you leaning toward' probe, so LEANERS. other = Graham 4 (Other vol. < 0.5); undecided = No opinion < 0.5 recorded 0; Would not vote 1 not folded in. The document's red note: 'This poll experienced significantly higher cooperation rates among registered Democrats than Republicans and additional signs of nonresponse error.' Topline PDF is a free document file (read in a browser before the coordinator's no-browser instruction; curl got no connection); the article itself (paywalled) was not read. Release date from the article URL (2026/10/30).

pollster.weighting_quote: The sample was weighted to match population estimates for the demographic makeup of Kansas registered voters ... Weighting factors: Race/Ethnicity, Education, White/Nonwhite by college grad/non-grad (CPS); Gender by age group, Party registration by general election turnout, 2024 Presidential turnout by vote method (L2 Kansas voter file); Kansas regions; 2024 Presidential vote choice by party (Federal Elections Commission, AP VoteCast)
pollster.mode: telephone: live callers on cellphones 74%, landlines 9%, cellphone text-to-web 17%; L2 voter file sample
